Please join us on Thursday, April 15th at 2:00 pm (EST) for a historic, live conversation about renewable energy with ALL four of the living Standing Rock Sioux Tribe (SRST) Chairmen of the last 40 years.

SAGE Development Authority is honored to welcome four esteemed panelists for our next Anpetu Wi Dialogue:

Charles Murphy
Former SRST Chairman
1983-93, 1997-2005, 2009-2013

Ron His Horse is Thunder
Former SRST Chairman
2005-2009

Dave Archambault II
Former SRST Chairman
2013-2017

Mike Faith
SRST Chairman
2017-Present

The panelists will discuss renewable energy during their terms, the current effort to build the Anpetu Wi wind farm, and their individual viewpoints on development at Standing Rock.

SAGE Development Authority's General Manager, Joseph McNeil, Jr., will moderate.

The conversation is part of our monthly talk series titled For Generations to Come: Anpetu Wi Dialogues from Standing Rock. The talks in the series are devoted to raising awareness for Native American issues and our efforts to develop Anpetu Wi – a utility-scale wind farm - on our ancestral land at Standing Rock.

It was 10 years ago that Hilcorp made its entry into Alaska and what an impact it’s made. Hilcorp is now the largest field operator in the state, based on operated oil and gas volume. It operates more than 1,700 producing wells, with gross production of about 345,000 barrels of oil/day and 150 million cubic feet of gas/day.

“We’re here to grow for decades to come,” Jill Fisk, Hilcorp Alaska senior asset team leader for Prudhoe Bay west, told the Resource Development Council’s annual conference.

At Prudhoe Bay, Hilcorp has halted the massive field’s 4%/year production decline without any major projects or drilling any new wells. It has experienced world-class results from Milne Point’s viscous oil in Schrader Bluff and is taking its polymer flooding technology to Prudhoe Bay.

“Alaska has clearly been a big win for Hilcorp, but we also believe our success in Alaska is a big win for Alaska and the people that live here,” Fisk said. You can watch Fisk’s entire presentation here. https://vimeo.com/647472375.
